steps.what: Reconcile investigation evidence, chronology and unresolved contradictions
Prepare written investigation report wording from the evidence pack

loop.input: Verified evidence pack and report template
loop.output: Draft report with each factual sentence linked to evidence and uncertainties preserved
loop.check: Investigator checks attribution, chronology, contradictions, omitted exculpatory evidence and separation of observation from inference
loop.stop: One draft; unsupported claims or missing evidence return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Narrative synthesis needs contextual wording beyond fixed report fields

steps.what: Confirm evidential accuracy and release the investigation report

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} templates first, then a bounded narrative draft from a verified evidence pack. The specialist checks every claim and releases the exact report; the system cannot infer guilt or fill gaps in the investigation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Narrative assembly repeats facts already gathered but still requires careful evidential wording.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-constrained drafting is plausible; this digest supplies no documented report-drafting case.
tasks.still_hard: Preserving uncertainty, contrary evidence and accurate attribution.
tasks.human_edge: Judge what evidence supports and accept responsibility for the account.
tasks.altitude: Less initial wording with unchanged investigative conclusions and release rights.

reach.learn: Distinguish verified facts from allegations and inference

evidence.claim: A bounded evidence-linked investigation report draft is a plausible design; its savings are unmeasured model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is report reconciliation, writing and release, excluding the investigation itself and later legal decisions. Source capture claimed in another task is not counted as a second saving.

Specialist produces the verified evidence pack in s1 with dates, source identifiers, observations, statements, contradictions and assignment scope. Its full 35 hours include extraction, checking and missing-source reconciliation; no free clean case file is assumed.
Test native templates first. Missing source support returns the section to manual writing, without invented facts.
Five additional focal hours cover source audits, template changes and exceptional failures; access and national investigation rules need local confirmation.
research_questions: Does drafting save total report time after sentence-level source verification and correction?

incremental.description: Source audits, template maintenance and draft failures

approvals.approved_version: Exact report wording, evidence references, uncertainty statements and recipient; edits require renewed release approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+27+20=82, gross=18, upkeep=5, net=13. High assumes 40% less composition effort for a complete verified evidence pack; low retains manual writing when contradictions require extensive rework plus upkeep. Investigation, reconciliation and final review retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Confirm relevant facts and permitted disclosure for law enforcement collaboration
Collaborate with law enforcement to report or investigate crimes

tasks.design: Retain disclosure judgement and direct law enforcement collaboration. Existing {DOCS} evidence supports the account; no separate report-writing saving is added to the report task's estimate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Disclosure and investigative cooperation depend on the case and agency needs.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability is assumed for this collaboration.
tasks.still_hard: Accurate disclosure, uncertainty and responding to follow-up questions.
tasks.human_edge: Explain the evidence and recognise limits to what can be claimed or shared.
tasks.altitude: Agency collaboration time and investigative authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Assess evidence received from a retailer
reach.learn: Understand evidence provenance and disclosure requirements

evidence.claim: Case-specific disclosure and investigative collaboration retain their human effort; no task-specific saving is supplied.

assumptions: Boundary is specialist disclosure preparation and collaboration, excluding law enforcement time and separate report composition.
Specialist produces the permitted account in s1 with review and capture fully retained. No automatic crime report or inference of guilt is assumed.
Use native evidence access first. Existing local disclosure rules and authority remain applicable; no changed workflow adds upkeep.
research_questions: Which evidence and uncertainties does the agency need to understand the case?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+60=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Disclosure assessment and direct collaboration retain their effort; agency time is excluded.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Testify truthfully in civil or criminal court proceedings

tasks.design: Keep testimony and answers to the court with the witness. Existing {DOCS} evidence may support permitted preparation; no generated account substitutes for personal recollection or sworn answers.
tasks.previous_blocker: The witness must distinguish memory, records and uncertainty under questioning.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability changes the witness's responsibility.
tasks.still_hard: Accurate recall and careful answers to unexpected questions.
tasks.human_edge: State what was observed and acknowledge what is not known.
tasks.altitude: Court attendance and testimony responsibilities remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Keep observation, documentation and inference distinct

evidence.claim: Court testimony remains personal witness work and earns no automation saving in this design.

assumptions: Boundary is witness testimony, excluding legal representation, report drafting and court administration.
Witness supplies answers from recollection and permitted evidence; no structured testimony input or generated answer is assumed.
Use existing evidence records where permitted. Unchanged testimony creates zero new upkeep.
research_questions: Can the witness clearly distinguish recalled observations from what was read later?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Personal testimony and court questions retain full witness time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend methods to reduce fraud losses

steps.what: Reconcile financial fraud loss evidence and control context
Aggregate verified financial losses and control exceptions for comparison
Recommend proportionate methods to reduce potential financial fraud losses

tasks.design: Configure {BI} summaries from reconciled {ERP} and case-loss records using explicit aggregation rules. The specialist checks coverage and recommends controls; totals and exceptions do not establish fraudulent intent or choose investigation targets.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated aggregation separates loss evidence from control discussions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reporting can reproduce totals and comparisons without model judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Unreported losses, inconsistent labels and the cost or side effects of controls.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish evidence from suspicion and recommend workable, proportionate changes.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated aggregation with unchanged advisory and investigative authority.

reach.task: Assess operational effects of proposed controls
reach.learn: Compare loss reduction benefits with practical burdens

evidence.claim: Deterministic loss aggregation and human control recommendations are plausible model knowledge; insurer fraud products do not establish retail recommendation savings.

assumptions: Boundary is specialist loss analysis and recommendations, excluding transaction capture, investigation, leadership approval and control implementation.

Specialist produces deduplicated case/transaction references, period, site, amount/currency, documented loss category, outcome status and control reference in s1. Its full 40 hours include extraction, reconciliation, field capture and unresolved-category review.
Finance and case owners maintain source records under unchanged processes; additional mapping maintenance is counted below. Missing categories remain unknown, not fraud findings.
Test native reports first. Missing fields, mixed currencies or unreconciled duplicates stop aggregation and return to manual reconciliation.
Four focal hours for mapping and sample checks and three finance/case-owner hours for additional source corrections are incremental.
unknowns: Authority and access for financial data
research_questions: Does automated aggregation save time after source reconciliation and control interpretation?

already_counted.description: Source reconciliation and verified dataset capture

incremental.description: Mapping upkeep and aggregation sample checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+0+35=75, gross=25, focal upkeep=4, net=21. High assumes genuine repeated manual aggregation with reconcilable records; low retains manual aggregation for inconsistent or sparse data plus upkeep. Reconciliation and recommendation judgement retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Evidence-based report composition and repeat loss aggregation may shrink; testimony, agency cooperation and control recommendations remain human.
reach: Check operational control effects with security supervisors
Clarify evidence provenance with police officers
role.ambitious_version: A loss prevention specialist with traceable reports and reproducible comparisons who retains accountable investigative and advisory judgement.
